Exhibits excellent track-specialist form with 6 starts at Scone yielding 2 wins and a second. Ran a solid 3rd at Tamworth last start and draws ideally in barrier 1 to map behind the leaders.
Resuming off a 5-month spell with a strong 2nd in a Gunnedah trial on July 20. Boasts consistent country benchmark form and picks up premier jockey Aaron Bullock.
Ran a close 2nd in Class 3 company at Tamworth last start following a Heavy-track Class 1 victory. Benefits from a 4kg apprentice claim, though wide barrier demands a good tactical ride.
Prepared by Rodney Northam on his home track. Placed 2nd on a heavy surface two starts back at Dubbo in BM58 grade. Capable of improving sharply back on a firmer Good 4 surface.
